_comment: VENDORED FROM plans/refactor-plan/05-deliverables/02-manifest-tooling/permission-catalogue.sample.json — this copy is the runtime source of truth shipped inside @tommy/manifest (a pinned @tommy/manifest version = a pinned catalogue version). The catalogue is FIXED and versioned (Phase 3 Q2) — MPs may only request scopes that appear here; @tommy/manifest validate layer 3 rejects any non-member with the named rule 'permission-not-in-catalogue'. This is the M1 STARTER set (covers every scope the reference manifest uses); the EXHAUSTIVE production catalogue is a deliberate, reviewed Tommy authoring task before M4 (README:68, security-model.md §2) — NOT an M1 gate. Growing it: add entries here, bump catalogueVersion, review. Scope form: verb:resource (verb in read|write|invoke). sensitivity (low|medium|high) drives review attention; deviceCapabilityRequired is checked against the device by the production manifest strip.

permissions.title: Read team members
permissions.description: View team member profiles in scope. Also required to use the team-member picker (tommy.ui).

permissions.title: Read own profile
permissions.description: View the current user's own profile.

permissions.title: Read locations
permissions.description: View locations the user may see. Required for the location picker (tommy.ui) and directory reads. Results are filtered to the user's permitted locations.

permissions.title: Read roles
permissions.description: View team roles. Required for the role picker (tommy.ui) and directory reads.

permissions.title: Read skills
permissions.description: View skills. Required for the skill picker (tommy.ui) and directory reads.

permissions.title: Read tags
permissions.description: View tags. Required for the tag picker (tommy.ui) and directory reads.

permissions.title: Read availability
permissions.description: View preferred shifts, availability windows and regular hours.

permissions.title: Write availability
permissions.description: Set preferred shifts, regular hours and lock/unlock availability windows.

permissions.title: Sync to accounting
permissions.description: Push data to a connected accounting integration (Xero/MYOB/QuickBooks/Reckon).

permissions.title: Manage training content
permissions.description: Create, edit or delete training videos and their watch-requirement definitions (video-kind DocumentType + the Video asset). Distinct from write:training_progress, which only records that a worker watched a video.

permissions.title: Read partner portal
permissions.description: View the partner organisation's profile, managed teams, referral codes, payouts and metrics rollup. Scopes reads to the managing partner (X-Partner-Id).

permissions.title: Manage partner portal
permissions.description: Create/edit/delete the partner's managed teams and referral codes, and enter a managed team (a host-mediated account switch). Does not cover the public referral-attribution or reward ledger, which remain server-side.

permissions.title: Subscribe to inbound messages
permissions.description: Receive inbound message/read/typing/block triggers from Team Comms as they arrive. Default-deny — an MP granted this sees only ACL-filtered events for conversations its installer may see. The inbound-notification privacy gate.

permissions.title: Read files
permissions.description: Read files from the MP's own storage scope.

permissions.title: Write files
permissions.description: Write files to the MP's own storage scope.

permissions.title: Use camera
permissions.description: Host-mediated photo capture via tommy.device.capturePhoto. The MP receives the photo, not a camera stream.

permissions.title: Scan codes
permissions.description: Host-mediated QR / barcode scan via tommy.device.scanCode.

permissions.title: Use location
permissions.description: Device geolocation — one-time (getLocation) or ongoing (watchLocation). Ongoing use shows a persistent host indicator.

permissions.title: Read network status
permissions.description: Online/offline and connection type via tommy.device.network.

permissions.title: Share content
permissions.description: Open the native share sheet via tommy.device.share.

permissions.title: Save image to gallery
permissions.description: Save an image to the device gallery via tommy.device.saveImage.

permissions.title: Read device info
permissions.description: Coarse device info (platform, OS version, model) via tommy.device.info.

permissions.title: Emit triggers
permissions.description: Emit triggers onto the Actions bus. Required only to emit triggers declared by OTHER MPs; emitting this MP's own manifest-declared triggers needs no scope.

permissions.title: Read tenant profile
permissions.description: View the tenant's display name and coarse role tags.
